instructions: Heat the oven to 275°F and set a large baking sheet next to the stove.
Pull the green tops off the strawberries and slice them. Put them in a bowl.
Cut 8 slices from the brioche with a serrated knife, each about 1 inch thick.
Separate the 4 eggs and put the yolks in a large bowl. You won't need the whites here, so keep them in the fridge for another dish.
Add the 2 cups half-and-half, the 1/3 cup sugar, the 1 tsp vanilla and the pinch of salt to the yolks. Whisk for about a minute, until the sugar has dissolved. Pour it into a wide, shallow dish.
Melt 2 tbsp of the butter in a large skillet over medium heat until it foams.
Lay 4 slices of brioche in the custard for 30 seconds to a minute, turning them once, until they're soaked through but still holding together.
Lift them into the skillet and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the underside is golden brown. If they're browning faster than that, turn the heat down to medium-low so the middle has time to set.
Flip them and cook the other side for 2 to 3 minutes, until it's golden too. Transfer them to the baking sheet and put it in the oven to keep warm.
If the butter in the skillet looks dark, wipe it out with a paper towel. Melt the last 2 tbsp butter, then soak and cook the other 4 slices the same way. Add them to the baking sheet.
Dust the 2 tbsp powdered sugar over the slices through a small sieve. Serve warm with the strawberries.
method_notes: All three soak thick slices of brioche in a sweet egg custard and fry them in butter until golden, keeping the first batches warm in a low oven. A Spicy Perspective (the lead) uses only egg yolks with half-and-half, sugar, vanilla and salt for a rich custard and a quick 30 to 60 second soak; GialloZafferano uses whole eggs, milk and cinnamon and serves it with a berry sauce, and Recipe Girl adds orange zest and Grand Marnier with strawberries and almonds. This follows the lead's yolk custard, scaled to 8 slices, and serves it the French way with powdered sugar and fresh strawberries rather than syrup. It leaves 4 egg whites over.
